messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up: FinEdge POC kickoff Mon. They require BYOK via their on-prem HSM proxy for encrypt/decrypt + signing. Need firewall steps, rotation behavior, perf impact, and POC billing model. Adding SE/Sec/Billing.

pat_se: Do they want full CMK in their HSM or wrapped-ephemeral? Also are calls per-request or batched? Impacts latency and design.

alex_sales: Customer wants full CMK, per-request encrypt/decrypt, plus occasional signing. They will route to our key-proxy over a TLS tunnel.

jordana_security: Need their security questionnaire Q3.4 (key custody) to answer. They also asked for HSM FIPS level and audit log export options.

customer_tech: Network note: egress NAT 10.40.0.0/16, TLS to your proxy, expect steady 300 RPS peak. Pen-test scheduled one week after POC.

mike_infra: Perf note: external HSM adds RTT ~20-40ms per op depending on region. If every token causes an HSM call you'll see high tail latencies. Recommend Redwood-side KV/prefix caching + batching.

pat_se: Typical key-proxy snippet we provide:
```yaml
key_proxy:
  endpoint: https://proxy.finedge.example:8443
  client_cert: finedge-client.pem
  allowed_ips: ["10.40.0.0/16"]
  caching:
    enabled: true
    ttl_secs: 120
```
With caching identical prefixes avoid HSM. Rotation still triggers HSM calls.

kate_account: Billing: POC can be hosted metered usage with a 15% pilot discount. If they require an SLA or sustained 300 RPS we should propose a short Dedicated quote.

alex_sales: Start metered +15% pilot discount. Add Dedicated transition conditions. Also confirm if zero-downtime rotation is possible.

jordana_security: We support canary rollouts: create new key version, dual-write during canary window, then flip. We must record who triggers rotations in SOW and retention of old versions for audit.

customer_tech: For attestation we need HSM cert chain and audit-log export (syslog or S3). What's default retention?

mike_infra: We can provide signed attestation + cert chain. Audit logs exportable to S3 or streamed; retention tiers 30/90/365 days; longer retention add-on. Logs include KEY_CREATE, KEY_ROTATE, KEY_ACCESS, KEY_DELETE events.

pat_se: Blocker: external pen-test against proxy requires preauth runbook, allowlisted scanner IPs, and a maintenance window. We'll need contact and timeline.

alex_sales: Action items:
- pat_se: draft key-proxy config + SOW rotation snippet (today)
- jordana_security: fill Q3.4 + assemble attestation package (EOD)
- kate_account: POC pricing email w/ 15% pilot discount + Dedicated triggers (tomorrow)
- mike_infra: latency estimate for FinEdge region + pen-test runbook

customer_tech: We'll send egress IPs and client cert by EOD. Request: mid-POC rotation dry-run in staging.

alex_sales: Mid-POC dry-run ok. We'll schedule after certs arrive.

mike_infra: For sustained 300 RPS we may recommend a small Dedicated pool for the POC to avoid noisy-neighbor variance; will quantify instances in the latency estimate.

pat_se: I'll include fallback: wrapped-ephemeral key flow if HSM latency unacceptable, plus cache TTL and cache-miss behavior.

jordana_security: I'll attach completed questionnaire responses and the JSON audit sample when ready.

alex_sales: Thanks all. I'll confirm kickoff time after cert + IPs are in. :thumbsup:
